foto-01.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: CACE Imatges N1 single-word vocabulary stimulus. Intended concept: CREMANT. ONE synthetic studio PHOTOGRAPH. Real camera realism, believable skin texture and hair, soft even neutral studio light. No illustration or cartoon. Subject: An adult light-skinned hand.. Visual content: A very hot metal frying pan on a minimal portable electric hotplate on white. An adult hand immediately recoils upward away from the metal rim, with fingers naturally spread; the hand does NOT touch the hot surface. Dense natural steam rises from the pan. Show both hand with anatomically correct five fingers and complete pan/hotplate. No burns, no injury, no fire, no warning icons, no text. The visual idea is TOO HOT TO TOUCH, scalding rather than comfortably warm.  Composition: ONE square image, pure white background, isolated clear subject, Complete objects comfortably inside the frame, generous white margins, no cropped handles or meaningful parts. Minimal context only when essential. NO text, labels, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, emoji, decorative symbols, arrows, borders, panels, collages or montage. Anatomically plausible proportions, correct eyes and mouth, no extra limbs or fingers. Appropriate for school use and varied ages. Produce ONE standalone image only.
